title: Coke Zoom-Out Reveal
creative_brief: A 12-second cinematic commercial shot featuring a close-up of a hand gripping a glass bottle of Coca-Cola that slowly zooms out to reveal a woman drinking from it in a sunlit urban setting.
global_visual_style: Cinematic realism, high-resolution photography, shallow depth of field transitioning to medium depth, warm natural lighting with soft highlights on the glass and condensation, vibrant red branding contrasted against neutral background tones.
overall_soundscape: Sharp plastic/glass capping sound, distinct liquid glugging sounds as the bottle is tilted, ambient city hum fading in as the camera pulls back, subtle breeze rustling hair.
non_diegetic_music: Upbeat, rhythmic indie-pop track with a steady bassline and bright synth accents that builds energy as the reveal happens.
constraints: Maintain strict continuity of the bottle's label orientation and liquid level. Ensure realistic hand grip physics. The zoom-out must be smooth and linear without jitter. No visible text overlays other than the product branding on the bottle.

shots.framing: Extreme close-up transitioning to medium shot
shots.movement_amplitude: High (from macro detail to full upper body)
shots.subject_action: A hand firmly grips the neck of a glass Coca-Cola bottle. The bottle is tilted slightly upward. As the camera zooms out, the woman holding it brings the bottle to her lips and takes a sip.
shots.environment_response: Condensation droplets on the glass catch the light. Background elements (city street/cafe) become visible and sharp as depth of field widens.
shots.additional_direction: Focus starts razor-thin on the hand and bottle label, then racks focus slightly to include the woman's face in the final third of the shot.

subject_keywords: hand holding bottle of coca cola
media_requests.prompt: Extreme close-up of a hand gripping the neck of a glass Coca-Cola bottle, red label clearly visible, condensation droplets on glass, shallow depth of field, cinematic lighting, 8k resolution
Medium shot of a young woman drinking from a glass Coca-Cola bottle, smiling slightly, wearing casual summer attire, sunlit urban background, cinematic depth of field, 8k resolution
